name: Multimodal AI & Vision-Language Applications
description: Multimodal LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro), vision-language processing, document OCR / visual understanding, audio/speech AI (Whisper, TTS, realtime voice APIs), image generation (Stable Diffusion, FLUX, DALL-E 3), video understanding, multimodal embeddings (CLIP), and ColPali visual RAG.

subskills.name: Vision LLMs & Visual Question Answering
subskills.description: Ingesting and analyzing images with Vision-Language Models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, LLaVA) using Base64 encoding, high-detail image tiling, and visual reasoning.

subskills.name: Speech-to-Text Transcription (Whisper & Faster-Whisper)
subskills.description: Transcribing audio streams and files using OpenAI Whisper and faster-whisper (CTranslate2): word-level timestamps, language detection, VAD chunking, and handling background noise.

subskills.name: Text-to-Speech & Voice Synthesis (ElevenLabs & OpenAI TTS)
subskills.description: Synthesizing natural voice from text using ElevenLabs API and OpenAI TTS: voice cloning parameters, stability/clarity tuning, SSML formatting, and audio chunk streaming.

subskills.name: Visual Document Parsing & Table Extraction
subskills.description: Extracting structured data, tables, and key-value fields from complex scanned PDF documents, invoices, and receipts using vision LLMs, bounding box coordinates, and visual layout understanding.
keywords: bounding box coordinates [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]

subskills.name: Cross-Modal Embeddings & Joint Search (CLIP & SigLIP)
subskills.description: Computing joint text-image embeddings using CLIP (OpenAI / OpenCLIP) and SigLIP: calculating cross-modal cosine similarity, zero-shot image classification, and text-to-image semantic search.

subskills.name: Programmatic Image Generation (FLUX, Stable Diffusion & DALL-E)
subskills.description: Generating and editing images programmatically using DALL-E 3 API, HuggingFace Diffusers library (FLUX.1, Stable Diffusion XL), ControlNet conditioning, and inpainting masks.

subskills.name: Realtime Bidirectional Voice Streaming (WebSockets & WebRTC)
subskills.description: Architecting low-latency, bidirectional audio streaming voice agents using OpenAI Realtime API (WebSockets), WebRTC, client-side Voice Activity Detection (VAD), and turn-taking interrupt handling.

subskills.name: Video Understanding & Temporal Event Reasoning
subskills.description: Processing video inputs for LLMs: frame extraction algorithms (uniform sampling, scene-change detection), Gemini 1.5 Pro native video ingestion, audio transcript synchronization, and temporal event detection.

subskills.name: Visual Document RAG & ColPali Multi-Vector Indexing
subskills.description: Implementing end-to-end OCR-free Multimodal RAG with ColPali (PaliGemma-based late interaction): embedding high-resolution page screenshot patches directly into multi-vector indexes for visual layout retrieval.
